name: dsh-plugin-rockdesk
description: RockDesk 远程控制电脑插件：让 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）按 9 位 ID 控制另一台电脑——终端（真实退出码）、文件、截屏、键鼠、剪贴板、端口转发，点对点连接，不用公网 IP、不用开端口；两台电脑都要装 RockDesk（https://rockdesk.cn/#download）。RockDesk for DeepSeek Harness: lets dsh work on your other computers through RockDesk's rds command line — shell with real exit codes, files, screenshots, mouse and keyboard, clipboard, port forwarding. Peer-to-peer by 9-digit ID, no open ports. Needs the RockDesk app on both machines: https://rockdesk.io/#download
author: RockDesk <dev@rockdesk.io>
